preconditions.description: The first line of input contains an integer T representing the number of games, where 1 <= T <= 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 10**9 for X in hidden_numbers)
preconditions.description: For each of the T games, there exists a hidden integer X such that 1 <= X <= 10^9.
The interactor is non-adaptive; the hidden number X is fixed before any queries for a specific game.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= Q <= 10**18 for Q in queries_per_game)
postconditions.description: Every query Q sent to the interactor must be an integer satisfying 1 <= Q <= 10^18.
For each game, the number of queries made must not exceed 22.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(ans - d) <= 7 or (0.5 <= ans / d <= 2.0) for ans, d in zip(final_answers, true_divisor_counts))
postconditions.description: For each game, the submitted answer 'ans' must satisfy the error tolerance: either the absolute difference between ans and the true number of divisors d is at most 7, or the relative ratio ans/d is between 0.5 and 2.0 inclusive.
Exactly one answer must be provided for each of the T games.
